# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v2 c26 P9](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel Colby is an extremely attractive young girl. She has rosy cheeks, along with dark eyes and hair.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses both goodness and intelligence, traits considered to surpass mere beauty.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)_

## Traits

- Good  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)</sub>
- Intelligent  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby resides at Pear Hill with her family and visited her aunt in Delford prior to returning home in the autumn. Upon her return, she becomes acquainted with Nell Harcourt and the two establish a close friendship, taking a solemn vow over a path to remain loyal bosom friends forever. She attends Brierley school, where she shares a seat with Nell and excels in her studies. Later in the season, she accidentally consumes currant wine at Grey Shutters under the impression that it is raspberry cordial, causing her to become ill. Later, she helps care for her sick sister, Posy Fay, when sheContracts croup.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c16 P20](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0020), [v1 c16 P22](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0022), [v1 c16 P35](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0035), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031)_
